name: FND_DOC_POST_RENDITIONS
description: New table tracking any artefacts that have been generated by the post processing that access could be requested for.

columns.name: DM_REPOSITORY
columns.description: Name of the repository that is providing file storage.

columns.name: OBJECT_BUCKET
columns.description: The name of the bucket that stores the file in the Object Store.

columns.name: OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the file in the Object Store.

columns.name: OBJECT_SIZE
columns.description: Size in bytes of the Object Store file.

columns.name: OBJECT_CONTENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the file being uploaded, using the MIME type assigned.

columns.name: FILE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the file to use when downloading.

columns.name: OBJECT_METADATA
columns.description: Additional custom information required as part of an upload for a specific repository.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
